description: User-selected fixed thresholds; independent pass/fail points. Screening hypotheses are unvalidated. Analyst coverage is disabled until a verified source is available.

factors.name: size
factors.description: Spinoff market capitalization in USD at or below the threshold.

factors.name: weakness
factors.description: Percentage decline from the first regular-way close strictly after distribution, at or above the threshold.

factors.name: insiders
factors.description: Documented insider equity ownership percentage, at or above the threshold.

factors.name: analysts
factors.description: Number of sell-side analysts covering the company, at or below the threshold. Disabled until a verified source is available.
